label: MPC70
note: Grades are named by protein as a share of dry matter (MPC60 is 60 %); diafiltration, adding water to wash lactose out, is what takes MPC past about 70 %

about.text: A milk protein concentrate powder of about 70 % protein in dry matter, the middle of the 40 to 90 % MPC range: skimmed milk ultrafiltered to hold back casein and whey proteins while lactose, minerals and water pass, then evaporated and spray dried. More protein and less lactose than MPC35 or MPC50, but short of the diafiltered MPC80 and above.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.text: Made like any MPC: pasteurised skim milk is ultrafiltered and the retentate evaporated and spray dried. About 70 % protein is roughly where plain ultrafiltration stops being enough and diafiltration (water added to wash lactose out) comes in; see the mpc and MPC80 entries for the membrane and diafiltration facts.
